officialSummary: In terms of GOI notification F.No. 4(4)-B(W&M)/2020 dated October 09, 2020 (SGB 2020-21 Series VIII - Issue date November 18, 2020) on Sovereign Gold Bond Scheme, premature redemption of Gold Bond may be permitted after fifth year from the date of issue of such Gold Bond on the date on which interest is payable. Accordingly, the next due date of premature redemption of the above tranche shall be on November 18, 2026. 2. Further, the redemption price of SGB shall be based on simple average of closing price of gold of 999 purity of previous three business days from the date of redemption, as published by the India Bullion and Jewellers Association Ltd (IBJA). Accordingly, the redemption price for premature redemption due on November 18, 2026, shall be ₹13,499/- (Rupees Thirteen Thousand Four Hundred and Ninety-Nine Only) per unit of SGB based on the simple average of closing price of gold for the three business days i.e., November 13, November 16, and November 17, 2026. Ajit Prasad Deputy General Manager (Communications) Press Release: 2026-2027/1512

officialSummary: The Reserve Bank of India issued Directions under Section 35A read with Section 56 of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949 to Nagar Sahakari Bank Ltd., Etawah, vide Directive No. LKO.DOS.SED.No.S29/12-03-000/2026-2027 dated May 15, 2026, for a period of six months up to close of business on November 18, 2026. The Reserve Bank of India is satisfied that in the public interest, it is necessary to further extend the period of operation of the Directive beyond close of business on November 18, 2026. 2. Accordingly, the Reserve Bank of India, in the exercise of the powers vested in it under sub-section (1) of Section 35A read with Section 56 of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949, hereby extends the Directive for a further period of three months from close of business on November 18, 2026, to close of business on February 18, 2027, subject to review. 3. The aforesaid extension and/or modification by the Reserve Bank of India should not per se be construed to imply that the Reserve Bank of India is satisfied with the financial position of the bank. 4. All other terms and conditions of the Directive under reference, shall remain unchanged. (Brij Raj) Chief General Manager Press Release: 2026-2027/1510
title: Directions under Section 35A read with Section 56 of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949 – Nagar Sahakari Bank Ltd., Etawah – Extension of Period
